title: Practice 1: Dative endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Синеватая птица летит к ___ (высокий) дереву.
exercises.prompt: A bluish bird is flying to the tall tree.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «дереву»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: His poor educational background was not a bar to his advancement.
exercises.ru: Его низкий уровень образования не стал препятствием к ___ продвижению.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «продвижению»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Не забудьте прийти к ___ (условленный) времени.
exercises.prompt: Don't forget to come at the agreed time.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «времени»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Acceptance of the document occurs only by mutual agreement of the parties.
exercises.ru: Принятие документа осуществляется только по ___ согласию сторон.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «согласию»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Его действия привели к ___ (неотвратимый) последствиям.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «последствиям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You must bear my advice in mind.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «совету»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Они быстро адаптировались к ___ (новый) среде обитания.
exercises.prompt: They adapted quickly to their new surroundings.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «среде»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The business was settled to everybody's satisfaction.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «удовлетворению»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Молодые люди склонны к ___ (юношеский) максимализму.
exercises.prompt: Young people tend to take things too far.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «максимализму»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Show that the matrix is diagonalisable.
exercises.ru: Докажите, что матрица приводится к ___ виду.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «виду»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Европу уже подташнивает от этого британского нытья по ___ (любой) поводу.
exercises.prompt: The continent is pretty sick of this British whining about anything and everything.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «поводу»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он был олимпийским чемпионом по ___ (тяжёлый) атлетике.
exercises.prompt: He was an Olympic champion in weightlifting.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «атлетике»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я очень много узнал о Германии благодаря ___ (немецкий) телеканалам.
exercises.prompt: I learnt a lot of things about Germany thanks to German TV channels.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «телеканалам»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The playful elephant calf chased egrets through the lush grass of the savannah.
exercises.ru: Игривый слоненок гонял белых цапель по ___ травам саванны.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «травам»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: По ___ (какой) критериям вы определяете, за кого голосовать?
exercises.prompt: What criteria do you use in deciding who to vote for?
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «критериям»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is learning to figure skate.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «катанию»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он тяготеет к ___ (левый) стороне политического спектра.
exercises.prompt: He leans to the left side of the political spectrum.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «стороне»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I trust your ability to know what to do instinctively.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «чутью»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Дождь стучал по ___ (оконный) стеклу.
exercises.prompt: The rain tapped against the window.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «стеклу»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: All immigrants are required to pass a Russian language exam.
exercises.ru: Все мигранты обязаны сдать экзамен по ___ языку.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «языку»: dative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
